text:
nia: Quick celebratory PSA — two tiny milestones today: got promoted to Senior PM and we closed on our first house!!! 🤯🏡🥳
omar: WHOA congrats, Nia!! double win!! :tada: :confetti_ball: 
kelly: omg amazing. cake time. what day are we celebrating?
doris: congrats!! ❤️ also deeply impressed you handled both in one week.
sam: huge!! bringing the solid +1 on cake. also +1 to dumplings?
nia: thanks y’all!! thinking friday afternoon at 4 in the lounge? low-key please, baby plants for the house over balloons 😂
anna: friday works for me. vote: cake vs dumplings vs empanadas? 
omar: dumplings all the way.
kelly: cake (chocolate + espresso), but dumplings are excellent backup.
doris: empanadas — represent latinx snacks here :raised_hands: 
sam: dumplings > empanadas > cake (but i will not judge you if you bring cake)
nia: love the variety. i made a dumb poll in threads: ```
1) Cake 🍰
2) Dumplings 🥟
3) Empanadas 🫓
```
(recruiter-bot): Reminder: team lunch RSVPs due 24h before event.
omar: I’ll bring dumplings (veggie + pork), I can also bring a small plant for Nia’s new place if you want one.
kelly: i’ll do cake and plates/napkins. chocolate espresso it is.
doris: empanadas from that spot on 12th if anyone’s into that — i can pick up.
sam: I’ll bring sparkling water and set up a tiny card where folks can write housewarming tips for Nia :)
nia: you’re all the best. low-key emotional. thank you. see you friday 4pm in the lounge — open invite to anyone who wants to swing by! :heart: :hugging_face:
anna: congrats again!!! can’t wait to meet the new houseplant :)
